title: agrostis alba var. albida
intro: Agrostis alba var. albida, commonly known as White Bent-grass, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the grass family (Poaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing due to its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis alba var. albida include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
